name: Porthos CO2 transport system, Port of Rotterdam, Netherlands
description: about 55 km of CO2 pipeline (about 30 km onshore laid, more than 20 km offshore); 10 Mtpa design; transports Rotterdam industry CO2 to depleted North Sea gas fields; under construction (2024-)
